structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Use of the title "Certified Nurse Aide" or "C.N.A."
law.text: No person shall use or assume the title "Certified Nurse Aide" or abbreviation "C.N.A." or any words, letters, signs, or devices to indicate that person is a certified nurse aide unless certified by the Board.
